details: A previously undetected firmware flaw, active since March 2021, in Coldcard hardware wallets has resulted in approximately $116 million in Bitcoin being stolen from over 5,200 addresses since July 30, 2026. The vulnerability compromised seed randomness, making private keys vulnerable.
title: Coldcard Firmware Exploit Drains $116M in Bitcoin

details: Cardano and Injective activated their first Inter-Blockchain Communication (IBC) testnet connection on August 4, 2026. This milestone creates a direct, trustless bridge for ADA and INJ assets between the Cardano and Cosmos ecosystems, significantly enhancing cross-chain interoperability and contributing to recent ADA price surges.
title: Cardano and Injective Launch First Live IBC Testnet Connection

details: On August 7, 2026, Bitcoin experienced a 0.8% decrease to $64,298, while Ethereum dropped 0.48% to $1,903.76. Despite these dips, Bitcoin spot ETFs continued to attract institutional capital, recording $137.6 million in net inflows on August 6, extending a four-day positive streak. However, a "risk-off" rotation impacted various altcoins.
title: Bitcoin & Ethereum See Slight Dips Amidst Positive ETF Inflows

details: A federal judge in Michigan on August 7, 2026, rejected Coinbase's attempt to prevent state enforcement of its planned sports event contracts. This ruling marks a significant legal setback for the exchange's efforts to expand into prediction markets, an area targeted for new revenue generation.
title: Coinbase Faces Setback in US Prediction Market Expansion

details: During the first week of August 2026, Wells Fargo made progress in its initiative to integrate blockchain technology for tokenized deposits. This move signals a continued trend of traditional financial institutions actively exploring and adopting crypto infrastructure for their services.
title: Wells Fargo Advances Blockchain-Based Tokenized Deposits

details: On August 7, 2026, CoinMarketCap enhanced its Pro API by introducing a new suite of seven real-world asset (RWA) data endpoints. This expansion provides developers with comprehensive programmatic access to data on tokenized versions of traditional financial instruments, including equities, commodities, and real estate.
title: CoinMarketCap Expands Pro API with Real-World Asset Data
